reason: The plugin is best classified as project-analysis because its documented tools operate on repository changes and commit history to produce development metadata (Conventional Commit messages, changelog, and version suggestions), with no evidence of external service access or high-risk behavior.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 Git 工作流助手插件，可根据仓库变更生成 Conventional Commits 风格的提交建议，并基于提交历史生成 CHANGELOG 与下一版本号建议。
summaries.en: This is a Git workflow assistant plugin that generates Conventional Commit-style suggestions from repository changes and can create changelog and next semantic version recommendations from commit history.

capabilities: Analyze git changes to suggest Conventional Commit messages
Generate changelog output from commit history

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a Git commit assistant that analyzes repository changes and generates conventional commit text, changelog, and semantic-version suggestions.
Package description and keywords in package.json repeat the same scope: conventional commits, changelog, and semver recommendation.
